sentences.en: Some historical buildings in Algiers still need some intensive care.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及尔的一些历史建筑仍需要一些加强性的维护。

sentences.en: Intensive care units and hospitals are on the verge of collapse.
sentences.zh: 重症监护病房和医院即将崩溃。

sentences.en: Wilson has been moved from intensive care to a regular room.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊已经被从重症监护室转到了普通病房。
